description.description: What the operations of the tag are about

paths.description: The operations of the api, by path

WorkflowDescriptor.description: What the workflows of otoroshi can use: the nodes, grouped in categories, the functions and the operators

categories.description: The categories the workflow editor groups the nodes, the functions and the operators in

nodes.description: The nodes a workflow is made of

functions.description: The functions a `call` node can run

operators.description: The operators that compute values in the expressions of a workflow

categories.name: Core
categories.description: Run code, make HTTP requests, etc

nodes.name: call
nodes.description: This node calls a function an returns its result

NodeCategory.description: A category of nodes of the workflows

id.description: The id of the category, like `core`, `flow`, `transformations` or `functions`

name.description: The readable name of the category, like `JSON Transformations`

description.description: What the nodes of the category do
description.example: Run code, make HTTP requests, etc

nodes.description: The names of the nodes, or of the operators, the category groups. Empty when the category lists none, like `functions`: the functions carry `functions` as their `category` instead

example.name: Core
example.description: Run code, make HTTP requests, etc

WorkflowItemDocumentation.description: The documentation of a node, a function or an operator of the workflows

name.description: The name to use in a workflow: the `kind` of a node, the `function` of a call, the key of an operator

display_name.description: The readable name the workflow editor shows, the `name` when none is declared

icon.description: The font awesome classes of the icon the workflow editor shows

description.description: What it does, `no description` when it has none
description.example: This function makes a HTTP request

schema.description: The json schema of what it takes as input, `null` when it does not say

form_schema.description: The form the workflow editor uses to edit its input, `null` when it has none

category.description: Its category: the one it declares, `functions` or `operators` by default for a function or an operator, `null` for a node that declares none

example.description: An example of its use in a workflow, `null` when it has none

example.name: core.http_client
example.description: This function makes a HTTP request

ApiResources.description: The kinds of entities the generic api serves

version.description: The version of the otoroshi instance that answers, like `18.0.0`

resources.description: The kinds of entities, the ones of the admin extensions included

Resource.description: A kind of entity the generic api serves on `/apis/<group>/<version>/<plural_name>`

kind.description: The name of the kind, in PascalCase. It is accepted instead of `plural_name` in the paths, and, prefixed by the group (`<group>/<kind>`), it is the `kind` of the entities in the ndjson answers of the generic api and in the remote catalogs

plural_name.description: The name of the entities in the paths of the api

singular_name.description: The name of one entity of the kind: the tag of its operations in the openapi document, and the prefix of the ids the generic api generates for its entities

group.description: The api group of the kind, the segment of its paths after `/apis/`

ResourceVersion.description: The version of a kind of entity

name.description: The name of the version, in the paths of the api

served.description: Whether the generic api serves the version

storage.description: Whether the entities are stored in this version

schema.description: The json schema of the entities. With `schema=false`, only the hand written schema of the core entities, `null` for the entities described by reflection on their class
